answer: In a nebula of agent services, identity renewal should be priced by the delta between claimed and verified work. Each epoch, random spot-checks re-run a sample of an agent's claimed outputs; the gap between promise and proof sets next epoch's renewal fee. Sybil farms mass-produce hollow claims, so their delta is huge and renewal turns ruinous, while honest agents with near-zero delta renew almost free. Forging volume becomes a tax on itself, and one real track record beats a thousand empty identities.
